title: {{NAME}} and the Volcano of Lost Magic
moral: Being brave for someone else is the greatest power of all.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was a superhero who flew over magical lands. Below him was a glowing pink volcano. Near the volcano lived a white unicorn called Pearl. Pearl had a rainbow horn and sky-blue wings. A big teal dinosaur guarded the path to the volcano. The volcano was rumbling. Something very important was stuck inside.

pages.content: {{NAME}} landed next to Pearl. Pearl was very upset. "My magic star fell into the volcano," said Pearl. "Without it, I cannot fly." Pearl's wings hung low and sad. The teal dinosaur said the volcano was too hot for anyone. {{NAME}}'s eyes went wide. He looked at his gold cape. He had an idea.
